result.question: What happens to the unbelieving captain?

readings.answer: He will see it with his own eyes but will not eat any of it.
readings.support: You will see it with your own eyes | but you will not eat any of it.

assessments.reason: Elisha says the doubting officer will see the event but not eat any of it, which in context refers to the flour and barley becoming available.

result.reason: The passage states he will see it but not eat any of it, matching the key’s meaning that he won’t eat the flour or barley.
